plugins.name: context-lens
plugins.description: Shows what fills your context window, what carrying it costs each turn, and what removing a memory file or MCP server would free.

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Counts down the prompt cache, warns before it expires, and can keep it warm with cheap pings while that costs less than a miss.

plugins.name: lessons
plugins.description: Catches loops as they happen, nudges the model out of them, and turns repeated mistakes into one-line rules you approve, each with its cost.

metadata.description: Three mods for Claude Code: context window, prompt cache, and loops.
